value.rationale: A natural 26-vertex, 4-regular projective incidence graph exhibits a sharp two-detector gap between RED and DET one-fault models; the theorem additionally classifies and counts every optimum and supplies the complete size polynomial. This is a meaningful, exact benchmark with a geometric explanation of the distinction, not simply a recomputation of previously known twofold-blocking minima.
